IA.name: Information architecture
IA.question: Can a user predict where something lives, and find it in one place?

ON.name: Onboarding
ON.question: Does a first-time visitor know what to do in the first 30 seconds?

FV.name: First visit
FV.question: Does anything look broken, locked or empty before the user has read a word?

PQ.name: Page quality
PQ.question: Does every page of the same type behave the same way, and are its numbers true?

PR.name: Production readiness
PR.question: Would this survive being shared on LinkedIn, indexed by Google and used on a phone?

CT.name: Content coverage
CT.question: Does the site cover what an FDE loop actually tests, and keep its core strength?

verify_methods.read: a person or subagent reads the pages
verify_methods.fetch: fetch a specific URL and look at status or content

checks.title: Top nav has 6 or fewer items
checks.pass_when: Header shows at most 6 content links (logo, search and theme toggle excluded)

checks.title: Worked designs (casebook) have exactly one hub
checks.pass_when: One index page lists the designs; any other index redirects to it

checks.title: Practice worksheets have exactly one hub
checks.pass_when: One index page lists the worksheets; any other index redirects to it

checks.title: Final-week reviews have one home
checks.pass_when: One section holds reviews, recall cards and cheat sheet; no parallel wrapper with different titles

checks.title: Worksheet and case-study twins are merged or labelled and cross-linked
checks.pass_when: Each design shows its practice worksheet as a tab or link, and the worksheet links back; labels consistent on all pairs

checks.title: No unlinked duplicate content
checks.pass_when: Material repeated between curriculum lessons and the casebook is merged or cross-linked both ways

checks.title: One name per thing
checks.pass_when: Nav label, hub H1, breadcrumb label and card title use the same words

checks.title: At most one user-facing numbering system
checks.pass_when: Codes like G01, T2.6, Review 05 are absent or shown only as small tags from one scheme

checks.title: One URL scheme, no .html or numeric-prefix paths
checks.pass_when: All content URLs follow the section/slug pattern; none end in .html or start /modules/NN-

checks.title: Breadcrumbs and back links lead to the hub the user came from
checks.pass_when: Breadcrumb and back links resolve to the section hub in the nav, not legacy hubs or homepage anchors

checks.title: Legacy URLs redirect permanently to their new home
checks.pass_when: Every retired URL returns 301/308 to the matching new page (not 404, not the homepage)

checks.title: Track and module numbering complete and in order
checks.pass_when: No gaps in visible numbering; lists render in numeric order

checks.title: Same item has the same title everywhere
checks.pass_when: A worksheet, case or review has one title across every hub and card

checks.title: List pages have filters
checks.pass_when: Casebook and practice lists filter by theme, level and time, with counts

checks.title: Every user feature reachable from visible navigation
checks.pass_when: Every user feature, including Settings, has a visible link in the header, footer or mobile menu at desktop and mobile widths

checks.title: Exactly one onboarding page
checks.pass_when: One page explains how to start and pick a path; other how-to pages are merged or redirect

checks.title: "Path" has one meaning
checks.pass_when: The word path refers to the same set of paths on every page

checks.title: Diagnostic linked wherever it is required or mentioned
checks.pass_when: Every mention of the diagnostic links to it; any exit criterion that needs it links to it

checks.title: Effort estimates agree across pages
checks.pass_when: Hours for paths, tracks and the course agree wherever they appear

checks.title: Every required module on every path is ready
checks.pass_when: No path marks a Coming soon or On hold module as Required, and no path skips a module only because it is paused

checks.title: Every path visible on the start page with its hours
checks.pass_when: All paths, including loop variants, appear as cards with hours

checks.title: Express lane for candidates interviewing soon
checks.pass_when: A visible link on home and start pages takes an interview-this-week user straight to final-week material

checks.title: Homepage has one dominant first step
checks.pass_when: One primary call to action, at most one secondary

checks.title: No Blocked or locked badges for a visitor with no progress
checks.pass_when: A visitor with no saved progress sees zero Blocked badges on paths, hubs and lessons

checks.title: No empty or paused areas reachable from the top nav
checks.pass_when: Every top-nav destination has real content

checks.title: No hub-level Coming soon or On hold cards
checks.pass_when: Section hubs show no Coming soon / On hold / Paused cards; unfinished items appear only as small labels inside lists

checks.title: Counts on the homepage match the hubs
checks.pass_when: Track, module, design, worksheet and review counts agree on home, hubs and guide pages

checks.title: No stub modules published with a Start button
checks.pass_when: Modules with no lessons are hidden or shown as Planned without a Start button

checks.title: Homepage interactive preview works
checks.pass_when: The write, compare, score preview accepts input and reveals the strong answer

checks.title: Readiness not shown as complete on thin data
checks.pass_when: The progress page shows no readiness percentage until at least 2 of its inputs are measured; below that it says how many are measured

checks.title: Every content page uses the site header, footer and search
checks.pass_when: No content page renders outside the shared shell

checks.title: Three or fewer body layouts
checks.pass_when: Lesson, case and worksheet variants only

checks.title: One objectives label
checks.pass_when: One wording for learning objectives sitewide

checks.title: One reading time per page, matching listings
checks.pass_when: Each page shows one reading time and it matches the time on its listing card

checks.title: Prev and next on every page in a sequence
checks.pass_when: Every lesson, case and worksheet in a sequence has both links where they exist

checks.title: Key takeaways on lessons and cases
checks.pass_when: Lessons and cases end with key takeaways

checks.title: No build artefacts on pages
checks.pass_when: No .md/.xlsx file paths, Generated-from footers, repo links as navigation, or empty tool lead-ins

checks.title: No internal codes in titles or H1s
checks.pass_when: <title> and H1 do not start with or contain codes like G01, #67, Review 05, T2.2

checks.title: No copy bugs
checks.pass_when: No doubled words, fragments, glued text, or claims that contradict the list beneath them

checks.title: One spelling system
checks.pass_when: British spellings throughout (behavioural, authorise); practise as verb and practice as noun is correct

checks.title: Module and track times equal the sum of their lessons
checks.pass_when: Stated total within 15% of the lesson sum

checks.title: No single page or tab above about 2,500 words
checks.pass_when: Long material is split into tabs or pages of 2,500 words or less

checks.title: Diagrams fit the content column
checks.pass_when: No diagram wider than its column; wide ones scale or offer a full-size view

checks.title: Diagrams render after load
checks.pass_when: No Drawing diagram placeholder remains 4 seconds after load

checks.title: Author and last-updated date on content pages
checks.pass_when: Every lesson, case and worksheet shows an author line and a last-updated date

checks.title: One scoring control per practice page
checks.pass_when: Each worksheet and mock page has exactly one scoring control

checks.title: Custom domain
checks.pass_when: Site served from its own domain; the vercel.app host redirects to it

checks.title: Share preview image
checks.pass_when: og:image (1200x630) on every page and twitter:card summary_large_image

checks.title: Canonical tag on every page
checks.pass_when: <link rel=canonical> on every page, pointing at itself on the primary domain

checks.title: Privacy-friendly analytics
checks.pass_when: An analytics script loads (e.g. Vercel Analytics, Plausible) and key events are tracked

checks.title: About and author page
checks.pass_when: An About page says who built the site, their FDE background and how to contact them; linked from the footer

checks.title: Report-an-issue or feedback link
checks.pass_when: Every content page links to a way to report an error or suggest an edit

checks.title: Custom 404 with navigation
checks.pass_when: Unknown URLs return HTTP 404 with the site shell and links back into the sections

checks.title: robots.txt and sitemap present
checks.pass_when: robots.txt returns 200 and names the sitemap; sitemap.xml returns 200

checks.title: Sitemap lists only canonical URLs, with lastmod
checks.pass_when: No legacy, .html or redirected URLs in the sitemap; every entry has lastmod

checks.title: Favicon, lang attribute, one H1 per page
checks.pass_when: All three on every page

checks.title: Mobile layout works at 390 px
checks.pass_when: Menu present and no horizontal page scroll at 390 px on home, a lesson, a case and a hub

checks.title: Fast first byte (static pages)
checks.pass_when: Median time to first byte under 800 ms over repeat loads

checks.title: Structured data
checks.pass_when: BreadcrumbList plus LearningResource or Course JSON-LD on content pages

checks.title: Content rights confirmed for derived material
checks.pass_when: Every credited source is marked licensed, permitted or rewritten; nothing derived from paid material without permission

checks.title: Public changelog
checks.pass_when: A dated changelog page exists and is linked from the footer

checks.title: Progress export and safe clearing
checks.pass_when: Users can export and import saved progress; clearing answers asks for confirmation

checks.title: Lighthouse 90+ on five page types
checks.pass_when: Performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO each 90+ on home, hub, lesson, case and worksheet

checks.title: Security headers
checks.pass_when: Framing blocked, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options and a content security policy present

checks.title: Error monitoring and uptime check
checks.pass_when: Owner confirms error tracking and an uptime monitor are configured

checks.title: Key content present in server HTML
checks.pass_when: Diagrams and lesson text are in the served HTML, not drawn only after JavaScript runs

checks.title: 404 page content in the served HTML
checks.pass_when: The served HTML for an unknown URL, before JavaScript runs, holds the 404 heading and links back into the sections

checks.title: Every design ends with level calibration
checks.pass_when: Each casebook design states what Senior, Staff and Principal answers cover

checks.title: Company loop guides for at least four companies
checks.pass_when: Guides with round-by-round format, timing, sample prompts and linked material for 4+ companies

checks.title: Coding-round practice
checks.pass_when: 10+ practical FDE coding problems with starter code and tests, plus AI-assisted coding guidance

checks.title: Client-simulation mocks and a take-home brief
checks.pass_when: 5+ role-play mocks with persona, hidden constraints and rubric; one take-home brief with example submission and rubric

checks.title: Feedback beyond self-scoring
checks.pass_when: Answers can get rubric-based AI feedback or peer review

checks.title: Reported questions and loop reports
checks.pass_when: A submission path exists and published reports are tagged by company and round

checks.title: Video or spoken practice for top designs
checks.pass_when: Walkthrough videos for the 10 most-read designs, or a timed speak-your-answer mode

checks.title: Casebook size and depth maintained
checks.pass_when: At least 33 worked designs remain, most with multiple depths (guards the core strength)

checks.title: Worksheets keep model answer, rubric and timer
checks.pass_when: Every worksheet has a hidden model answer, a scoring rubric and a timer

checks.title: Final-week recall material present
checks.pass_when: Condensed reviews, one-page recall cards and the cheat sheet are all reachable

C1.title: No author, About page or update dates

C8.title: No reported questions or candidate experiences

S1.title: Same content behind several hubs, long nav, many numbering systems

S2.title: Competing start pages and meanings of path

S3.title: Many page layouts; final-week pages outside the template

S4.title: Blocked badges on first visit; no filters

S5.title: Empty areas in the top nav

S6.title: Launch basics and visible build files
